## Settings › Positions bucket: tick NEW_1 onto Screen A (the first screen)
  1  GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
  2  PUT /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
       {
         "nodes": [
           "POS_A1",
           "POS_A2",
           "POS_A3",
           "POS_A4",
           "POS_A5",
           "POS_A6",
           "POS_A7",
           "POS_A8",
           "POS_A9",
           "POS_A10",
           "POS_A11",
           "NEW_1"
         ]
       }
  3  GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
  4  GET /api/processes/1/composer
  5  GET /api/process-nodes
-- sheet closed

## Settings › POS_A11 › Remove (the impact is read before the sheet opens)
  1  GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
  2  POST /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes/impact
       {
         "nodes": [
           "POS_A1",
           "POS_A2",
           "POS_A3",
           "POS_A4",
           "POS_A5",
           "POS_A6",
           "POS_A7",
           "POS_A8",
           "POS_A9",
           "POS_A10"
         ]
       }
  3  GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
  4  PUT /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
       {
         "nodes": [
           "POS_A1",
           "POS_A2",
           "POS_A3",
           "POS_A4",
           "POS_A5",
           "POS_A6",
           "POS_A7",
           "POS_A8",
           "POS_A9",
           "POS_A10"
         ]
       }
  5  GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
  6  GET /api/processes/1/composer
  7  GET /api/process-nodes
-- sheet closed

## Operator screens › Loader windows › Make a screen on Press A (LDR_1)
  1  POST /api/loader-boards
       {
         "loader_key": "LDR_1",
         "process_id": 1
       }
  2  GET /api/operator-stations
  3  GET /api/processes
  4  GET /api/processes/1/composer
  5  GET /api/processes/1/styles
-- sheet closed
